translations.web: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
translations.bsb: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
translations.kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth
translations.asv: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep shallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.
